_comment: Column-name tokens that mark free-form prose. Matched as a lowercase SUBSTRING of the
column name, so 'kommentar' also catches 'bemerkung_kunde' style variants via its own
entry and 'kommentar_2'. A match forces is_this_col_violating_1nf to 0 for that column;
the column stays in every other statistic. See TASK_3_PLAN.md Phase 0.5.
- Short generic tokens ('text', 'info', 'version'): as substrings they would also hit
- Audit and soft-delete columns (created_at, updated_at, modified_by, is_deleted,
active, import_id, batch_id): they never trip the list detector and violate neither
2NF nor 3NF. They become relevant only for the column-pair features, where a
single-batch created_at fabricates dependencies to everything.
